failure_summary.description: Agents imported a nonexistent `tools` module instead of calling injected tool functions directly.
Agents searched again or sorted results instead of filtering compatible cached results for newly supplied criteria.
Agents failed to map explicit shorthand such as a solo traveler or an approximate budget to the corresponding tool parameter.

patch.reasoning: The import and cached-result failures already violate explicit skill rules, so repeating those rules would not patch a skill gap. The skill does not yet specify how to map the explicit shorthand seen in this batch to supported hotel parameters.

edits.target: Match arguments only to fields declared by the selected tool’s schema, with the expected type and cardinality.
edits.content: Interpret explicit shorthand in clarification answers as supplied values: a “solo” or “one traveler” hotel request means `num_people=1` (but does not imply a room count), and an approximate maximum budget stated as “around/about X” maps to `budget=X`.
